steps.path: The version chip, the update popup, Settings → Help & feedback and the close-window prompt
steps.headline: The contract, graded — accept these verdicts?

rows.statement: Install updates automatically can be switched off in Settings or the update popup, beside Get beta builds, and both stay in sync.
The switch looks like Get beta builds, with a circular-arrows icon and the description "Downloads new versions by itself", and starts on.
rows.evidence: re-shot docs/active/design/2026-10-22-auto-updates/runs/grade/settings/help#updates/midnight.png; approved images/auto-updates.review-2/settings__help~updates--midnight--after.png; same wording, order, icons and layout; Get beta builds toggle, Install updates automatically with circular-arrows icon, 'Downloads new versions by itself', switch on

rows.statement: Get beta builds and Install updates automatically sit together under their own Updates heading in Help & feedback.
rows.evidence: re-shot docs/active/design/2026-10-22-auto-updates/runs/grade/settings/help#updates/midnight.png; approved images/auto-updates.review-2/settings__help~updates--midnight--after.png; same wording, order, icons and layout; both rows under an 'Updates' heading

rows.statement: Once an update has downloaded, the version chip keeps its yellow pulse.
Once an update has downloaded, the version chip still shows the version and says it is ready and a restart is needed.
rows.note: no still keep the version. my b

rows.statement: The update popup says Update ready, that it installs when you next quit, and offers Restart to update from one version to the next.
rows.evidence: re-shot docs/active/design/2026-10-22-auto-updates/runs/grade/chat/update#ready/midnight.png; approved images/auto-updates.review/chat__update~ready--midnight--after.png; same wording, order, icons and layout; 'Update ready', 'Installs by itself the next time you quit YouCoded', 'Restart to update: v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0'. Chip now 'v1.4.0 - Ready - restart needed' per round 2 (R2-1)

rows.statement: Where installing needs a password, the popup says restarting asks for it, and quitting never pops up a password box.
On package installs, a password box appears only after you press Restart to update, never without you asking.
With the switch off, the popup line reads "Downloaded. Restart when you are ready." and changes the moment you flip the switch.
rows.evidence: re-shot docs/active/design/2026-10-22-auto-updates/runs/grade/chat/update#ready-manual/midnight.png; approved images/auto-updates.review/chat__update~ready-manual--midnight--after.png; same wording, order, icons and layout; switch off, line reads 'Downloaded. Restart when you are ready.'. Live flip not shown in a still; UpdatePanel.test.tsx 'says installs by itself only when the switch is on AND a quit really will install' covers the switching of the line

rows.statement: Pressing Restart to update while chats are open shows the standard close prompt with the Resume on Next Launch switch.
rows.note: just show the standard closeout prompt that offers to resume sessions and stuff. if a user chooses not to exit by closing the prompt, cancel the restart.

rows.statement: Closing that prompt with the X cancels the restart and leaves the app running.
rows.note: just show the standard closeout prompt that offers to resume sessions and stuff. if a user chooses not to exit by closing the prompt, cancel the restart.

rows.statement: The restart prompt is titled Restart to update, says restarting ends your active sessions, and its red button reads Restart.
rows.evidence: re-shot docs/active/design/2026-10-22-auto-updates/runs/grade/chat/quit-sessions#update/midnight.png; approved images/auto-updates.review/chat__quit-sessions~update--midnight--after.png; same wording, order, icons and layout; title 'Restart to update', 'Restarting will end your active sessions...', red Restart button

rows.statement: A broken release is pulled by removing its signed list; apps stop offering it and drop it before installing if already downloaded.
People on a pulled release see no automatic message; any notice goes out through the announcement chip when worthwhile.
On a Mac that refuses the swap, the update still downloads by itself and quitting does not install it.
On that Mac, Restart to update shows the Mac's password box and then installs; cancelling or a failure opens the disk image.
On a Mac that needs a password, Restart checks the downloaded update is still there first, and otherwise opens the disk image.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-service.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: update-service.test.ts 'Restart when the staged copy has gone missing (F1)': re-stages before any password, falls back to disk image

rows.statement: On a Mac, the password-powered install checks and installs a copy that only the administrator can alter.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-staging.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: update-staging.test.ts 'root mode: an app swapped into the user-side folder AFTER the signature check is never installed (F2)' and 'swapped in while being copied fails the check on the copy'

rows.statement: A switch you turned off stays off even when the saved setting cannot be read at that moment.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-service.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'keeps a saved off when a later re-read fails' (line 176)

rows.statement: A release whose signed file was removed is no longer offered, on stable or beta; beta offers the next good one.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-release-status.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'does not offer a release whose signed files were removed' and 'on the beta listing a pulled release is skipped and the next good one is offered'

rows.statement: The popup says the update installs by itself on quit only when a quit really will install it.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/UpdatePanel.test.tsx (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'says installs by itself only when the switch is on AND a quit really will install'; service test 'the status says a quit will install only when it really will'

rows.statement: If Restart cannot get the install ready in time, it says so instead of quitting and reopening the old version.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-restart.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'tells the person now when the install cannot be prepared, instead of quitting and reopening the old version (F6)'

rows.statement: When Restart fails, the popup shows the real cause or a general error, never a made-up installer or network cause.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/UpdatePanel.test.tsx (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'a Restart that fails for no installer reason is not called an installer failure; it shows the general error with the real text'

rows.statement: A download that keeps failing waits longer between tries instead of re-downloading the whole update every half hour.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-service.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'does not start the same failing download again at every check (F8): backs off 1 h, then 2 h'

rows.statement: Pressing Update now while old downloads are being tidied never loses the download that is starting.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-service.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'a download started while the stale-file sweep is still reading the folder waits for it (F9)'

rows.statement: The Mac helper leaves no leftover update files after waiting, and a stale install signal cannot trigger an unwanted install.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-staging.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'waits for the app to exit, and gives up after its limit... removing its staging' and 'stale go files at startup (F10)'

rows.statement: If you quit just as a restart finishes, a later Restart press is not wrongly refused as busy.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-restart.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'frees the launch lock when a shutdown takes over after the installer ran (F11)'; also update-service.test.ts releaseLaunch test

rows.statement: Your saved automatic-install choice is read when YouCoded starts, so the popup shows it right away.
rows.evidence: cd youcoded/desktop && npx vitest run tests/update-service.test.ts (5 update test files run together, 219 passed, 0 failed); read test: 'reads the saved switch at startup, not only when something first asks (F12)'
